subject: Kickoff: model fit & consumption mapping for ClearPath onboarding
messages:
From: Sally Park <sally@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, ops@clearpathhealth.com
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: model fit & consumption mapping for Redwood onboarding

Hi Marcus (and Redwood team),

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday — excited to get this onboarding going. Quick recap of our core needs so you have context before the kickoff:

- Product: clinical summary generation from structured EHR + clinical notes (short free-text + structured fields).
- Expected average request size: ~450 tokens input, target generation ~120 tokens.
- Critical requirement: maintain PHI isolation; we will be on a Private deployment.

For planning, can you provide an initial model shortlist and a first-pass token consumption profile (daily/weekly expected tokens, and peak QPS assumptions)? We want to understand: 1) context length options (2k vs 8k vs 32k), 2) potential batching/latency tradeoffs, and 3) any obvious model performance vs cost recommendations you have for our workload.

Attached is a small sample payload and a CSV showing current hourly traffic for the last week (patient_snippet_sample.json, hourly_traffic_sample.csv).

Also: our compliance team needs a brief note on where KV/prefix caching would sit in the architecture for this Private deployment — is that something you can include in the kickoff deliverable?

Can we target a short kickoff doc by Fri so our engineering team can validate assumptions before the tech deep-dive?

Best,
Sally Park
Head of ML Ops, ClearPath Health
Sally.Park@clearpathhealth.com

Attachment: patient_snippet_sample.json (application/json)
Attachment: hourly_traffic_sample.csv (text/csv)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sally Park <sally@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: model fit & consumption mapping for ClearPath onboarding

Hi Sally — thanks for the notes and the samples, very helpful. Quick ack and an initial pass from our side below. We will produce a short kickoff playbook by Friday with model candidates, cost/latency sketches, and a recommended context profile.

Initial model shortlist (reasoning):
- LlamaX-7b-quant (2k/8k context): strong cost/latency for template-like summarization; recommend for low-latency endpoints and high-QPS routes.
- RedToken-13b (8k): better factuality for complicated note stitching; higher cost but fewer hallucinations in early tests. Good middle ground.
- LongForm-33b-int8 (32k): only for multi-note consolidation where we need 30k+ context; use for nightly batch jobs or canary routes, not default.

Preliminary consumption assumptions we need you to confirm (fill in numbers if different):
- Avg input tokens: 450 (as you noted)
- Avg output tokens: 120
- Typical session: 1–3 calls per patient flow
- Expected baseline traffic: 200k tokens/day (you mentioned rough numbers on call) — please confirm.
- Peak multiplier: 2.5–3x (evening processing window)

Operational notes / suggested architecture items to include in kickoff doc:
- Use 8k context as the default unless multi-note consolidation is required. 2k limits will reduce quality for stitched notes.
- Enable prefix/KV caching for stable patient metadata (IDs, templates) — reduces per-request compute by ~8–12% in our internal tests.
- Recommend starting with automated batching with a 25ms latency SLO window for lowest-cost routing; we can tune after a 48–72 hour pilot.

I've attached an initial scoring sheet (model_shortlist_scores.xlsx) and a token profile export (clearpath_token_profile.csv) that contains a rough hourly distribution we inferred from the CSV you sent.

Can we schedule a 30-min technical deep dive Thu or Fri next week to validate QPS and security requirements?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachments: model_shortlist_scores.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), clearpath_token_profile.csv (text/csv)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Sally Park <sally@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: model fit & consumption mapping for ClearPath onboarding

Thanks Marcus / Sally — quick ops perspective to add:

- Context-length distribution: please run a short scan to confirm what fraction of requests will need >8k. If >10% require >8k we should plan a mixed fleet (8k + 32k) from day one.
- Quantization: for RedToken-13b we recommend int8 as the default for Private deployments; int4 may be possible later but needs end-to-end evals for accuracy drift.
- Caching: prefix caching should be applied at the request-router layer in Private deployments; we will capture audit logs for cache hits/misses. Ops will provide a short snippet for where caching sits in the network diagram in the kickoff doc.
- Rollout: suggest a canary route for 10% traffic on the cheaper model, escalate if quality regressions are detected by your eval prompts.

Also: Marcus / Monica — can your team produce a small script to export 7 days of raw request/response sizes (anonymized) so we can validate token multipliers? Sally — if your team can share that by EOD tomorrow it will speed sizing.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success (Implementation), Redwood Inference

From: Sally Park <sally@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 16:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: model fit & consumption mapping for ClearPath onboarding

Thanks everyone — confirming numbers so you can lock the kickoff doc: we ran the anonymized export this morning and key picks below (export attached to our Drive link):

- Confirmed avg input tokens: 470 (slightly higher after cleaning)
- Confirmed avg output tokens: 130
- Baseline expected tokens/day: 210,000
- Peak concurrency: observed hourly peak ~3x baseline (evening batch window) => plan for 630k tokens/hour ceiling for the peak hour
- Multi-note consolidation: ~7% of flows need >8k context; low but important for nightly consolidation.

We are ok with the suggested shortlist and the pilot plan — please include the following in the kickoff doc: 1) suggested default model (RedToken-13b int8, 8k), 2) explicit fallback to LlamaX-7b for low latency routing, 3) nightly batch pipeline using LongForm-33b-int8 for consolidation at lower SLO.

I've uploaded an anonymized 7-day payload export and a short explainer in the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c45clearpath

We can do Thu 09:00 PT for the technical deep-dive. Also attaching a short demo recording of our current summarization flow (demo_recording.mp4).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the kickoff playbook.

Best,
Sally Park
Head of ML Ops, ClearPath Health
